binary: # Branch protection requires only the "CI success" job. To add a check, add a
# job here and list it under ci-success.needs; no GitHub settings change.
# Go jobs run on macos-26: the app is cgo + WebKit, and `wails3 generate icons`
# compiles build/appicon.icon with actool, which needs Xcode 26+. Jobs that
# only need Node or the pure-Go CLI run on Linux. The *-linux jobs build the
# Race detector on Linux: the slowest job, on the cheapest runner. Covers the
# shared engine and the Linux-only paths; darwin-only code (FSEvents, cgo
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-4-dev libwebkitgtk-6.0-dev libxml2-utils
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libxml2-utils
# Playwright drives the real Svelte UI in headless Chromium against a mocked
# Wails bridge (frontend/e2e/helpers/mock-bridge.ts) seeded from the committed
# fixture, so it needs no Go backend, no `claude`, and no native window.
# macOS because the specs assume ⌘ chords, CodeMirror's mac keymap, and mac
# native editing (Meta+A); Linux Chromium sends Ctrl for ControlOrMeta.
# Ad-hoc signed arm64 Recur.app in a DMG. Also fails if the build regenerates
# committed Wails bindings or go.mod/go.sum (someone forgot to commit them).
Committed bindings and go.mod are current
if [ -n "$drift" ]; then echo "$drift"; git diff -- frontend/bindings go.mod go.sum; exit 1; fi
# Lint and test the Linux build: the fsnotify watcher and other non-darwin
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-4-dev libwebkitgtk-6.0-dev libxml2-utils
